claims.text: Trello offers four pricing tiers billed per user.
Trello's Free plan has a monthly price of $0 with annual billing.
Trello's Free plan includes up to 10 boards.
Trello's Free plan includes unlimited cards.
Trello's Free plan includes 250 workspace command runs/month.
Trello's Free plan includes 10MB file attachments.
The monthly price of Trello's Standard plan is $5/user with annual billing.
The monthly price of Trello's Standard plan is $6/user if billed monthly.
Trello's Standard plan includes unlimited boards.
Trello's Standard plan includes advanced checklists.
Trello's Standard plan includes custom fields.
Trello's Standard plan includes 1,000 automation runs/month.
The monthly price of Trello's Premium plan is $10/user with annual billing.
The monthly price of Trello's Premium plan is $12.50/user if billed monthly.
Trello's Premium plan adds Timeline, Calendar, Table, Dashboard, and Map views.
Trello's Premium plan adds Atlassian Intelligence (AI).
Trello's Premium plan includes a 14-day free trial.
Trello's Enterprise plan is from $17.50/user annually.
Trello's Enterprise plan requires a minimum of 50 users.
The price per seat for Trello's Enterprise plan decreases as more users are added.
Trello's Enterprise plan includes SSO, Atlassian Guard, and org-wide permissions.
Non-profits receive 75% off Standard and Premium plans.
Non-profits receive 50% off Enterprise.
Academic institutions receive 50% off all paid plans.
Asana starts at $10.99/user/month.
Asana has a free plan available.
Asana offers task dependencies, milestones, and multiple views (List, Board, Timeline, Calendar, Gantt).
Monday.com Basic plan starts at $9/user/month.
Monday.com has a 3-user minimum.
Monday.com Standard plan is $12.
Monday.com Pro plan is $24.99.
Monday.com has 10+ project views.
ClickUp has a free plan available.
ClickUp paid plans start at $7/user/month.
ClickUp Business plan is $12.
ClickUp has 15+ views (including Mind Maps and Whiteboards).
ClickUp has built-in docs.
ClickUp has integrated time tracking.
ClickUp can suffer from performance issues.
ClickUp can suffer from feature clutter.
Notion combines task management with documentation and databases in an all-in-one workspace.
Trello focuses strictly on visual Kanban task tracking.
Trello has a starting paid price of $5/user/month.
Asana has a starting paid price of $10.99/user/month.
Monday.com has a starting paid price of $9/user/month.
ClickUp has a starting paid price of $7/user/month.
Trello has a Capterra rating of 4.5/5 based on 13,871 reviews.
Trello has a Software Advice rating of 4.5/5 based on 13,872 reviews.
Trello has an Apple App Store rating of 4.7/5 based on 3,632 reviews.
Trello has a Google Play rating of 4.6/5 based on 84,421 reviews.
Trello has a Trustpilot rating of 2.2/5 ("Poor") based on 226 reviews.
Trustpilot reviews include recent complaints about billing cancellation difficulties.
Trustpilot reviews include recent complaints about AI-only support.
SmartSuite (2026 review) scored Trello 9/10 for UI/usability and customer support.
SmartSuite (2026 review) scored Trello 7/10 for range of features.
SmartSuite notes Trello lacks built-in collaboration and reporting capabilities compared to alternatives.
Tech.co ranked Trello among the best simple project management providers.
Trello has Butler automation (no-code) for streamlining repetitive tasks.
Trello has mobile apps.
Trello has a notification system.
Atlassian's Trello redesign drew harsh criticism from users.
Headlines called the Trello redesign potentially the "worst in tech history".
Users complained that boards were repositioned as individual workspaces in a confusing layout.
Users report interface lag when handling many tasks.
Trello lacks built-in time tracking (requires Power-Ups).
